title: Home insulation survey and payback data sheet
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Metals and their uses (8G); energy transfers (8K)
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 55 (Home insulation survey and payback data sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 55. Do the survey with an adult, then use the example data to rank insulation methods by payback time.

questions.q: Work out the payback time for each method (cost ÷ saving per year).
questions.a: Loft 2 years; cavity wall 4 years; draught excluders 1.5 years; double glazing 20 years

questions.q: Rank the methods from shortest payback to longest.
questions.a: Draught excluders, loft insulation, cavity wall foam, double glazing

questions.q: Why might a family still choose double glazing?
questions.a: It also reduces noise, condensation and draughts and adds comfort.
